# Players who may join the development server.
#
# One name per line. Blank lines and anything after a # are ignored.
#
# The names are resolved to UUIDs against Mojang's API when the server's
# whitelist is built, so a typo here fails the deploy rather than
# silently locking someone out.
#
# The whitelist only takes effect when the server is restarted, because
# Minecraft reads it at startup.
